messages:
alice (customer): Hey team — our PROD calls to /v1/invoke started failing ~10:23am UTC. Getting 400 from the tool call layer: 'tool_schema_validation_error'. Impacting payments flow. Request id: req_0a1b2c3d

jessica (support): Sorry — can you paste the full error payload + the request body you sent? Also which SDK/version?

alice (customer): Here's the raw payload we sent (sanitized):
```json
{
  "tool": "charge",
  "args": {
    "amount": 1999,
    "currency": "USD",
    "billing": "standard",  // we used a short string here
    "debug": true
  }
}
```
Error from Redwood: `{"type":"tool_schema_validation_error","detail":"additionalProperties: (debug) not allowed, and /args/session: required property missing"}`

jessica (support): Thanks. Noted SDK v2.1.0. Escalating to eng — @kevin can you triage?

kevin (eng): Investigating. From the error looks like two issues: (1) /args/session is required by our tool schema and is missing, (2) /args/billing expected an object (profile/ref) but got a string, and the extra `debug` field triggers additionalProperties rejection. Do you have the raw request headers + content-type?

alice (customer): Content-Type: application/json, auth header present (Bearer token). We only started seeing this after a client rollout ~09:45 — they shipped a tiny refactor that converted billing to a string.

samir (oncall): Any chance this is a newer schema change on our side? We didn't roll a schema change to prod this morning AFAIK.

kevin (eng): Confirmed no schema deploys today. Likely the client change triggered strict validation we always had. Repro locally with alice payload -> same 400. Quick repro commands:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '@payload.json'
```
(where payload.json contains the snippet above)

kevin (eng): Root cause: our function JSON schema for tool `charge` requires `args.session` and expects `args.billing` be an object with id/type. Also schema disallows additionalProperties. The customer client accidentally sent `billing` as a string and dropped `session`. That triggers the validation error you saw.

jessica (support): Proposed short-term mitigations? Customer is blocked in PROD payments.

kevin (eng): Short term: we can add a temporary tolerant fallback in the gateway for the charge tool that attempts to coerce a string billing into a {"profile":"standard"} and fill a missing `session` with a generated ephemeral session tied to request id. This will be a quick patch but must be gated behind a canary. Longer term: update SDK to fail on serialization errors and add server-side telemetry & clearer 400 with expected schema details. I'll open a ticket.

jessica (support): Please add priority. I'll notify the customer that we're working on a temporary fallback and request they rollback client rollback if possible.

kevin (eng): Created ENG ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4722 (hotfix + SDK fix). Implementing hotfix now, will push to staging then canary.

deploy-bot: Started rollout INF-4722 -> staging (build bld-2026.03.17-0812).

samir (oncall): Once canary looks good, we can enable the transform for the affected tenant only. Also add a rule to log occurrences where billing is string so we can notify customers proactively.

alice (customer): Thanks — can you add our tenant id T-8891 to the canary? We can also ship a rollback from our side if needed, but the hotfix would be faster.

jessica (support): Done, adding T-8891 to canary list. I'll follow up with incident summary + ETA. :thumbsup:

kevin (eng): Hotfix merged to staging. Running gateway tests. Expect canary in ~12m. Will post updates in this thread.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment INF-4722 live (tenants: T-8891).

kevin (eng): Canary looks clean for T-8891 — validation now coerces billing string -> object and injects ephemeral session only when missing. Logging enabled. Please verify with your prod traffic.

alice (customer): Verified — errors stopped and payments resumed. Huge help, thanks everyone.

jessica (support): Closing loop with customer. Action items: (1) Kevin to ship SDK fix and schema guidance, (2) Samir to add telemetry dashboard + alert for malformed tool args, (3) Support to email customer postmortem.

kevin (eng): Will follow up with PR numbers and timeline on INF-4722. Also recommending we add a schema-change notice process for breaking schema changes.

jessica (support): Sweet. Marking this resolved for now. If anything new pops up ping here. :white_check_mark:
